name: @conductor/mcp-ado
description: MCP server exposing Azure DevOps PR/iteration/comment tools (ado.get_pr, ado.list_pr_comments, ado.comment_pr, ado.list_iterations, ado.get_pr_status) to Conductor recipes. Wraps the ADO REST API; auth via ADO_BEARER_TOKEN (AAD, preferred) or ADO_PAT (basic-auth fallback). Default org/project resolved from ADO_ORG / ADO_PROJECT env vars when not supplied per-call.
